title: CloudFormation Guard correctness
impact: Policy automation earns trust when each result traces to a rule that loaded, executed, and produced the intended decision.
caption: Public code branching through repositories, commits, and files. Each beat shows up to six representative commits and ten highest-change files. Exact commit-to-file routes come only from sampled GitHub details; grouped routes preserve the reviewed pull-request shape. The composition is not a claim of literal Git ancestry.

nodes.label: Fix usize underflow when a violation is reported on line 0 or 1
Require callers of eval_when_condition_block to name the clause role
Stop applying an index twice after an interpolated map key
Stop an unanswerable clause from discarding the whole rules file
Stop citing commit hashes that rebasing has already invalidated
Split the other two condition sites by role
Say what a non-string password is, instead of relying on membership
Pair the orphaned test suites with their rules, and drop one duplicate
Fix two case titles that state the opposite of what the case tests
Cover templates that carry more than one of the named resource types
Decompose cfn_no_explicit_resource_names into its fourteen per-type rules
Say why the per-rule when guards are load-bearing
Rename file-level variables that collide when packs are concatenated
Fix buildDockerRelease: pass -r, and gate the ECR push on the tests
Check the built rule set packs in CI
Stop reading a non-finite float out of a document
Keep `cfn-guard test` results when a rule cannot be evaluated
Report a vacuously-satisfied negated clause as SKIP, not as nothing
Follow the settled empty-reference semantics in the zero-selection matrix
Refuse a range literal that no value can satisfy, instead of accepting it
Tell users that a backslash in a rule literal changed meaning
Stop validate reporting a verdict it did not reach
Take the amended stringify_scalar_key, which cannot hand back a default
